Before you gather documents, make a plan.

The paperwork can come from different parts of your life and from more than one country. A little structure helps you see what to check, who it concerns, and what can wait.

Start your plan

This is a planning tool, not a visa document checklist.

Requirements depend on the visa, the people applying, and individual circumstances. Do not upload files or enter passport numbers, medical information, or other private details here. Your pathway choice and checkmarks stay in this browser on this device.
